about: India Motor Parts & Accessories Ltd (IMPAL), incorporated in 1954 and part of the T.S. Santhanam/TSF Group, is an asset-light pan-India distributor of OEM-quality automotive replacement parts and accessories. It sources products from around 30 component manufacturers and distributes through 99 branches across 23 states and over 23,000 aftermarket dealers. [1] [2] [3]
